name: Missing Superposition Setup
hint: A superposition-start handler can run only when a superposition operation is executed for that actor. Without such an operation, the script is unreachable and its response never occurs.
instruction: Execute a suitable superposition operation for the same actor before the event is expected, or remove the handler when that state is not needed.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when superposition started :: events hat #5c068c
forever
turn right (15) degrees
wait (0.1) seconds
end
